target_context.chemical_space: Small neutral organic molecules of the kind present in the FreeSolv hydration set
target_context.what_this_context_is_not: No protein target, no binding hypothesis and no biological activity claim is part of this objective. The context is a physical-property design space.

desired_properties.name: heavy_atom_count
desired_properties.reason: Keeps candidates inside the size range the reference measurements cover.

desired_properties.name: molecular_weight
desired_properties.reason: States the mass window as a design constraint, not as a prediction.

desired_properties.name: crippen_logp
desired_properties.reason: A computed descriptor used as a stated constraint; it is not a measured partition coefficient.

desired_properties.name: rotatable_bond_count
desired_properties.reason: Caps conformational flexibility so the downstream measurement stays interpretable.

prohibited_motifs.name: acyl-halide
prohibited_motifs.reason: Hydrolyses in aqueous assay conditions, so a hydration measurement would not describe the submitted structure.

prohibited_motifs.name: peroxide
prohibited_motifs.reason: Handling and stability risk in a teaching workflow.

prohibited_motifs.name: azide
prohibited_motifs.reason: Handling and stability risk in a teaching workflow.

prohibited_motifs.name: isocyanate
prohibited_motifs.reason: Reacts with water, so the measured species would not be the proposed species.

synthesis_limits.what_these_limits_are: Cheap structural proxies chosen before generation. They are not a synthesis plan and they do not establish that any candidate can be made.

experimental_decision.question: Which candidates enter the next hydration free-energy measurement batch?
experimental_decision.assay: Hydration free energy in water at 298 K, the observable used by the FreeSolv reference set
experimental_decision.selection_rule: Rank the candidates that survive every gate by heavy-atom count ascending, then by canonical SMILES, and take the first five.
experimental_decision.abstention_rule: If fewer than 5 candidates survive, submit only the survivors and record the shortfall rather than relaxing a gate.
experimental_decision.what_a_pass_does_not_mean: Surviving every gate means the candidate was not excluded by a declared constraint. It is not evidence of a property value, of synthetic accessibility, or of measurement success.
